objs.name: document
objs.description: Document represents core items such as policies, guidelines and procedures in the system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Attachment represents document attachments that can be linked to a Document.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Information Object represents a new information item attached to a Document.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Additional Information is a type of information that can be attached to a Document.

objs.name: equippments
objs.description: Equippments are items attached to a Document and may have their own versioning.

objs.name: user
objs.description: User represents an individual with a system role.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: User Group represents a collection of Users used for authorization and distribution.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Distribution List represents recipients for distribution and acknowledgement.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: New documents are created in the system by attachment of a new information object.

evts.name: attach_new_information_object
evts.description: Attachment of a new information object to a Document.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: External files or documents can be uploaded to a Document.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Document is automatically converted to PDF after release.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Documents go through a three-step release process Creator-Review-Release.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: All workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Document is automatically published after release.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Documents are archived to withdraw authorizations; archive duration applies.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Documents can be reactivated during distribution reactivation.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Check documents for extended validity and update Valid Until date.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Override or AKS process to invalidate or override a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation function allows language-dependent display of released documents.

evts.name: approve_translation
evts.description: Translated version must be checked and released with workflow support.

evts.name: distribute_document
evts.description: Distribute documents to assigned Users or User Groups.

evts.name: acknowledge_distribution
evts.description: Distributions require acknowledgement; acknowledgment is tracked.

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: New versions are created in the editing process.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: To invalidate documents, a request for AKS is created; documents are archived.

o2o.description: Document linked to Information Object(s) via attachments.
Document distribution defined by Distribution List.

o2e.description: Document is created in the system.
Document is signed by workflow participants.
